mapper.select: select * from approval_node_approver where del = 0 and flow_node_id in #{nodeId}
mapper.insert: insert into approval_node_approver (flow_node_id, approver_type, approver_value, superior_level, del, add_time, update_time) values (#{flowNodeId}, #{approverType}, #{approverValue}, #{superiorLevel}, #{del}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update approval_node_approver set del = 1, update_time = #{updateTime} where del = 0 and flow_node_id in #{nodeId}
